note: Compact separated sets are eventually in `NoHit` by `room` with `no_wrap_hit`, the volume tables converge uniformly on compact generic sets, the ordered integral limit holds and all persist on refinement. The derivative convergence (eq:F-conf) is not part of this step.

snippet.text:
structure RawLimits (S : Table C.book) (P : ℕ → Table C.book) : Prop where
  regular (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → C.book.Token) : ContinuousOn (fun x => S.read x v) (generic n)
  mesh : f.Meshes C P
  volume : f.VolumePoints C S P
  integral : f.Ordered C S

proof_context.conclusion: `RawLimits` packages continuity of S on generic points, locally uniform convergence of the volume tables (`mesh`, `volume`) and the ordered smear limit `Ordered`.

snippet.text:
theorem room {K : Set (Points n)} (H : IsCompact K) : ∀ᶠ p : ℕ in atTop, K ⊆ Inside S p n := by
  have hi (i : Fin n) (a : Axis) : ∀ᶠ p : ℕ in atTop, ∀ x ∈ K,
      -(S.radius p) < x i a ∧ x i a < S.radius p := by
    obtain ⟨R,hR⟩ := (H.image (show Continuous fun x : Points n => |x i a| from by fun_prop)).bddAbove
    filter_upwards [S.radius_diverges.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop R)] with p hp
    intro x hx
    exact abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (hR ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩) hp)
  filter_upwards [eventually_all.mpr (fun i => eventually_all.mpr (hi i))] with p hp
  exact fun x h i a => hp i a x h

proof_context.conclusion: Every compact K lies in `Inside S p n` for all large p.

snippet.text:
theorem no_wrap_hit {p : ℕ} {x} (h : x ∈ Inside S p n) : x ∈ NoHit S p n ↔ x ∈ conf n := by
  constructor
  · intro H i j he
    by_contra hh
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := H i j hh
    exact ha ((scalar_periodic S p _ _ (h i a).1 (h j a).1 (h i a).2 (h j a).2).2
      (congr_arg (fun w : E4 => w a) he))
  intro H i j hij
  by_contra! he
  exact hij ((show Injective x.ofLp from H) (PiLp.ext fun a =>
    (scalar_periodic S p _ _ (h i a).1 (h j a).1 (h i a).2 (h j a).2).1 (he a)))

proof_context.conclusion: For x inside the period box, x in `NoHit S p n` iff x in `conf n`.

snippet.text:
theorem copy_down {P} {S} (h : RawLimits C f S P) (g) : RawLimits C (f.refine g) S P :=
  ⟨h.regular, ⟨h.mesh.continuous, fun p n K hh he v ε hε => g.mesh.cofinal.eventually (h.mesh.onK p n K hh he v ε hε)⟩,
    fun n K hk he v ε hε => g.per.cofinal.eventually (h.volume n K hk he v ε hε), Order.upon h.integral g⟩
